zh-HK: Power BI Excel 匯入可在首 20 行自動識別真正欄名，Invoiced Sales、Order Sales 及 Stock Available 無需再手動刪除報表 metadata
NB coupon restore 會按月份及 Account 回填 Sales／Cash Margin，支援前置零帳號配對、避免重複 adjustment，並為極端 Margin 加上說明提示
定期訂單新增每月兩次及農曆日子排期，使用香港天文台 2025–2028 對照資料；CSV 密碼視窗亦新增 Power BI Invoiced／Ordered 報表捷徑
en: Power BI Excel imports now detect the real header within the first 20 rows, so Invoiced Sales, Order Sales and Stock Available exports no longer require manual metadata-row removal
NB coupon restoration now merges Sales and Cash Margin by month and account, matches account numbers with leading-zero differences, avoids duplicate adjustments and explains extreme margin results

Scheduled orders now support twice-monthly and lunar-day schedules using the Hong Kong Observatory 2025–2028 calendar; the CSV password dialog also adds shortcuts to the Power BI Invoiced and Ordered reports
